documentation: Incremented each time a command is processed (accepted or refused). Lets the HMI match a result to its write.
name: CmdCounter

documentation: Result of the last command (CntrlCmd or UnitModeRequest) processed.
name: CmdResult

documentation: PackML state command. Write a non-zero value; the PLC executes or refuses it within one scan (100 ms), writes C01.Command.CmdResult, increments C01.Command.CmdCounter, then writes 0 back.
name: CntrlCmd

documentation: Requested speed. The PLC clamps it (see C01.Status.MachSpeed) and maps it to RB01 speed override.
name: MachSpeed

documentation: Unit mode request (1 Production, 2 Maintenance). Same handshake as CntrlCmd. Accepted only in Stopped, Idle, Complete or Aborted.
name: UnitModeRequest
